name: khepri
description: 自用运动分析。第 1 段：网页与服务端素材流程。

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @khepri/server" "npm run dev -w @khepri/web"
scripts.start: npm run build -w @khepri/web && npm run build -w @khepri/server && npm run start -w @khepri/server
scripts.check: npm run check -w @khepri/server && npm run check -w @khepri/web
